name: Tag
purpose: Display compact metadata with optional navigation and removal.
intent: Represent entities, categories, and classifications throughout LegacyHQ. Statuses and states are Label's job (decided 2026-10-23).

apiAdaptationNotes: isInteractive has no corresponding Figma variant - added 2026-08-20 so Tag can be composed as a plain focusable button trigger (no navigation, no remove affordance) elsewhere in the system. Gated as isInteractive || typeof onClick === 'function', the same pattern Avatar already uses for its own isInteractive prop. First consumer: Tag Group's '+N more' overflow tag, which opens a Dropdown Menu on click.

keyboardInteraction: Tab navigates independently between link and remove button
Space/Enter activates the interactive tag button when isInteractive (or onClick with no href/isRemovable) is set - native button behavior, no custom key handling
behaviorRules: Navigation and removal are separate interactive regions.
Remove button uses independent hover, press, and focus states.
Tag body uses tone-specific interaction states.

When there is no href and isRemovable is false, isInteractive (or a plain onClick) renders a native button instead of a non-interactive span - no navigation, no remove affordance, just a focusable click target. In a removable tag without href, isInteractive or onClick makes the content area a native button beside the remove button; the remove button's click never reaches onClick.
Disabled state is the native-named disabled prop. isDisabled is a deprecated alias mapped to disabled; disabled wins when both are set.

tabIndex and aria-describedby go to the link or the interactive button when there is one (the content anchor in a removable linked tag); otherwise to the root span (display-only, or the wrapper of a removable tag without href or onClick).
themeRules: tone holds accent colors with no fixed meaning, for telling kinds of records apart, like Icon Tile's tone. Named tone to match Icon Tile, kept by decision on 2026-10-23. A status or a state is a Label.
implementationNotes: Rounded clipping handled by painted child surfaces.
do: Use for categories and classifications; use Label for a status or a state.
dont: Merge navigation and removal into one interactive target.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a native button (not a span) when isInteractive or onClick is set with no href/isRemovable
In a removable tag without href, isInteractive or onClick makes the content a native button, separate from the remove button
Takes disabled; the deprecated isDisabled still works
Forwards tabIndex and aria-describedby in every form
